description: When the person says to put it live: returns what going live does (every step, in order, and its cost) and the one command they run themselves to approve it in their own wallet (`npx -y @xgamesfun/solana@0.25.0 approve`, pinned to this exact version: give it as it is): it opens a local page where they connect a devnet wallet and approve each transaction. You never sign, never ask for a key, and never run the approval for them.

example.description: A worked example by name, from xsolana_examples (coin-flip-arena, stud-farm, …).

file.description: A JSON file holding the spec, relative to the project folder (default: xsolana.json when it exists).

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_publish
